task: Cookie farm: show the country flag in the report modal, and expand site list + consent patterns for reliable cookie collection

recon.detail: Recon of the reported defect: profiles created with a proxy showed 'Not checked yet'. Traced createProfile -> no proxy check on any non-Proxies-page door; page.cookies() origin-scoped under-count; consent matcher exact-equality only. All three measured against real sites/browser.

manifest.detail: R01-R04 with verbatim operator quotes; each names executed evidence (geoLabel output DE/US/FR, queue status fail with no country, measured cookie counts 0->164, consent 16 clicked/17 refused)

interfaces.detail: 6 boundaries with owners; signatures verified against source. Key invariants: evaluateTextConsent cannot close over module scope so the forbidden list is a required parameter (no default, or refusal protection silently drops); resolveExitGeo is intentionally unexported so the modal cannot re-derive a country at render time.

openspec.detail: openspec validate --strict: valid. 5 MODIFIED/ADDED requirements in specs/cookie-robot/spec.md with scenarios covering session-scoped cookie count, prefix consent matching + refusal list, site pool invariants, stored exitGeo, and auto-queued proxy geo across all binding doors.

oracle.detail: VERDICT: ACCEPT (independent blind oracle agent OracleGeoAcceptance, 12m14s, judged against the operator's verbatim brief not the author's spec). All 6 gates true: exit_geo_liveness, geo_on_create, version_integrity, falsification_fail_path, renderer_guards, consent_matcher_tested. Confirmed: createProfile->queueGeoChecks; failure path nulls country/country_code; flagOf /^[A-Z]{2}$/ rejects names; 0.6.48 synced across package.json/tauri.conf.json/Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock. It also falsified the consent rule and found a live gap - 'Accept nothing', 'Accept none', 'Accept minimal cookies' were still clicked - which was FIXED (nothing/none/zero/minimal/minimum + DE/FR/ES/IT equivalents), guard extended to 25 refuse cases, 18 legitimate labels re-verified as still clicking.
